alive.last_commit_message:
Re-pin the gate to the 1.0.18 image (#69)

0c63c260 -> 61cb0609, the digest the rebuild from 467e78d published. The old pin
predates every backend change in #67, so the gate was certifying the previous
backend and proving nothing about the new routes.

61cb0609 was booted before it was pinned, not looked up. /live reports 1.0.18,
which is the assertion that forced this into its own commit -- run_smoke.py:466
compares the pinned image's own version against the version declared in this
source, so the pin can only be written after an image built from that version
exists. Also confirmed on it: snmpwalk, git-dumper and manspider resolve on the
backend's PATH, /vpn exists at boot, job_output?timeout=120 answers 200 rather
than 400, cancelling a finished job answers 200 rather than 409, and send-raw
answers {"error": "Session x not found"} rather than Flask's HTML 404 -- which is
the only way to tell a present route from an absent one when both are 404.

The ordering is worth stating because it is not obvious from the symptom. A
single commit carrying both the bump and the pin fails the gate by construction,
and it fails with a message that reads like the pin is simply stale:

  pinned image reports version '1.0.17', expected '1.0.18': the integration
  digest is stale and must be re-pinned to an image built from this source

The gate's pull_request paths cover integration.yml, tests/integration/**,
tests/test_live_tools.py, mcp_tools/** and the compose files -- not pyproject.toml
and not zebbern-kali/**. That exclusion is what makes the sequence possible: the
bump merges without the gate running, the config.py change rebuilds the image at
the new version, and only then can the pin be written. Bump first, pin second, and
nothing in CLAUDE.md's release steps says why.
